# gitrepository

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/internal/cache/gitrepository"
```

gitrepository.go constructs this controller's GitRepository domain cache: a thin wrapper around blanketops\-environments\-core's cache/gitrepository package.

The cache itself, and the write path that populates it, live in the external core library; this file owns only the constructor.
